title: B1 Final Exam: Corporate Master
completion_message: ¡ENHORABUENA! HAS COMPLETADO EL NIVEL B1. Ahora posees un sólido dominio del inglés corporativo, la gramática intermedia-avanzada y el vocabulario clave para triunfar en los negocios. ¡Prepárate para el nivel B2!

parts.visual:
Este es el gran examen final. Evaluaremos todo lo aprendido en el nivel B1: 
- Pasiva, Reported Speech, Condicionales (1, 2, 3). 
- Phrasal Verbs de negocios (Set up, call off).
parts.audio: This is the grand final exam. We will evaluate everything learned in the B1 level: The Passive Voice, Reported Speech, Conditionals 1, 2, and 3, and Business Phrasal Verbs.

parts.visual:
También pondremos a prueba tu vocabulario ejecutivo: 
- Finanzas, Marketing, Entrevistas, Legal, RRHH. 
- Modismos (Game changer, think outside the box). 
¡Demuestra que eres un Corporate Master!
parts.audio: We will also test your executive vocabulary: Finance, Marketing, Interviews, Legal, Human Resources, and Business Idioms. Show that you are a Corporate Master!

stages.title: B1 Master Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío final de 20 preguntas (Nivel B1 completo).

questions.question: The report ____ by the CEO yesterday. (Voz pasiva - fue firmado).
He told me that he ____ tired. (Reported Speech - estaba).
questions.explanation: Reported speech: is cambia a was.

questions.question: If we launch the product today, we ____ money. (Primer condicional - ganaremos).
If I ____ you, I would accept the offer. (Segundo condicional - fuera).
If they had invested, they ____ a profit. (Tercer condicional - habrían hecho).
questions.explanation: If + past perfect, would have + participio.

questions.question: The manager ____ hired me is from Canada. (Pronombre relativo - persona).
I need to ____ up a meeting for tomorrow. (Organizar).
They offered me $1000, but I ____ it down. (Lo rechacé).
Friday is the ____ for this task. (Fecha límite).
If you don't pay, it's a ____ of contract. (Incumplimiento).
We need a bank ____ to buy the new office. (Préstamo).
questions.explanation: Loan = préstamo (Mortgage es específicamente para casas).

questions.question: They don't sell to the public, they only sell ____. (Al por mayor).
We are going to give you a salary ____. (Aumento).
Let's get down to ____. (Ir al grano / A trabajar).
In the US, you should ____ hands when you meet someone. (Dar la mano).
Who is the ____ of the company? (Director Ejecutivo).
I am in ____ of the marketing team. (A cargo).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave (Gramática y Vocabulario del Nivel B1).

questions.question: It ____ signed yesterday. (Voz pasiva - fue con W)
If I ____ you... (Condicional - fuera con W)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase de tu examen final B1.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If I were you, I would invest.
options: If I were you, I would invest.
If I was you, I will invest.
If I were you, I will invest.
If I am you, I would invest.
questions.correct_answer: If I were you, I would invest.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If we had launched earlier, we would have won.
options: If we had launched earlier, we would have won.
If we launched earlier, we would win.
If we had launched earlier, we will win.
If we launch earlier, we would have won.
questions.correct_answer: If we had launched earlier, we would have won.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: We are currently ahead of schedule.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I applied for a bank loan.
options: I applied for a bank loan.
I applied for a bank line.
I applied for a bank mortgage.
I applied for a bank account.
questions.correct_answer: I applied for a bank loan.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: We need to boost our sales.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I am in charge of sales.
options: I am in charge of sales.
I am in charge of marketing.
I am in charge of the team.
He is in charge of sales.
questions.correct_answer: I am in charge of sales.
